description: Unit tests for SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier, testing notification behavior, observer management, config loading, invalidation, and refresh functionality.

classes.name: SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifierTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier notification behavior.

classes.name: SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifierTest::TestObserver
classes.description: Observer implementation for capturing and waiting for DNS config change notifications during tests.

methods.name: LoadConfig
methods.description: Loads a DNS config into the notifier and waits for it to be received.

methods.name: ReceiveNotification
methods.description: Test case verifying notification receipt for a single config change.

methods.name: ReceiveNotification_Multiple
methods.description: Test case verifying multiple notifications for multiple config changes.

methods.name: ReceiveInitialNotification
methods.description: Test case verifying initial notification when notifier already has a config loaded.

methods.name: ReceiveInitialNotification_Multiple
methods.description: Test case verifying notification for the most recent config when multiple configs are loaded before observer addition.

methods.name: NotificationsStopAfterRemoval
methods.description: Test case verifying no notifications are received after observer removal.

methods.name: UnchangedConfigs
methods.description: Test case verifying no notifications for duplicate configs.

methods.name: UnloadedConfig
methods.description: Test case verifying notification when config is invalidated (unloaded).

methods.name: UnloadedConfig_Multiple
methods.description: Test case verifying only a single notification for multiple config invalidations.

methods.name: InitialConfigInvalid
methods.description: Test case verifying behavior when initial config is invalid and then replaced.

methods.name: RefreshConfig
methods.description: Test case verifying that a refresh triggers a notification with the new config.
